metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters
  name: "Find Parameters Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for configuring multi-modal search filters."

udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters"
kind: menu
type: "menu"
title: "Set Search Parameters"
header:
  type: "search_params"

items:

  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.locations.select-project-scope"
    label: "Add/Remove Search Path(s)"
    description: "Add or remove project search paths (supports multiple entries)."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search-location"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters.file-type"
    label: "Add/Remove File Type(s)"
    description: "Filter search results by artifact type."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters.text-query"
    label: "Add/Remove Text Queries"
    description: "Search by keyword, title, or semantic fragment."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters.tags"
    label: "Add/Remove Tags"
    description: "Restrict search using canonical tags or semantic labels."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "5"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters.canonical-only"
    label: "Search Canonical Folders Only (Y/N)"
    description: "Limit matches to canonical registry entries."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "6"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.parameters.recursive"
    label: "Search Folders Recursively (Y/N)"
    description: "Toggle recursive folder search."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
